name: Flying Tulip USD
oneLiner: ftUSD is Flying Tulip's stablecoin minted 1:1 against USDC or USDT, with deposits supplied to Aave for low-risk carry; a delta-neutral leg is planned.
collateral: USDC and USDT supplied to Aave for low-risk interest; this stablecoin lending is the only on-chain strategy currently live, with the delta-neutral leg (borrow a native asset such as Sonic S against the deposits and stake it for carry) documented as a staged roadmap item; distributed strategy yield routes to sftUSD stakers while unstaked ftUSD proceeds accrue to the protocol treasury
pegMechanism: Mint and redeem 1:1 against USDC or USDT through on-chain MintAndRedeem contracts; deposits are currently supplied to Aave for low-risk carry, with a delta-neutral leg (borrow a native asset against the collateral and stake it) documented as a staged roadmap item targeting net market exposure near zero; ftUSD circuit-breaker contracts enforce position caps, rebalancing bands, and withdrawal rate limits

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Flying Tulip contract docs list separate ftUSD core and mint/redeem contracts on Ethereum and Sonic, and sale docs note bridging is not necessary when assets are held on the right network. The row is reviewed as native per-chain issuance with no material bridge route.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: ftUSD on both Ethereum and Sonic is controlled by the same 3/5 Safe (0x1118e1c0): it is token owner, masterMinter, and owner of the minter contract (0x56c5892b). The minter contract is a UUPS proxy (impl 0xf47bb65f on Sonic) with no separate ProxyAdmin. Identical ownership confirmed on both chains.

controls.label: ftUSD minter contract
controls.evidence: minter() returned this address at Ethereum block 25166592; Flying Tulip docs describe 1:1 mint/redeem against USDC/USDT through on-chain contracts. At block 25295183: eth_getCode returned 76 bytes (small contract, not an EOA); owner() on the minter contract returned 0x1118e1c057211306a40a4d7006c040dbfe1370cb (the 3/5 Safe that is also masterMinter), confirming the Safe controls the minter contract.

controls.label: ftUSD token owner / masterMinter
controls.evidence: owner() and masterMinter() both returned this address at Ethereum block 25166592; Safe API returned a 3/5 Safe with no enabled modules and the zero guard. The minter contract (0x56c5892b...) is also owned by this Safe (confirmed at block 25295183).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295183: minter contract 0x56c5892b... has 76 bytes of code; owner() returns 3/5 Safe 0x1118e1c0. At Sonic block 73503133: owner() = 0x1118e1c0, masterMinter() = 0x1118e1c0, minter() = 0x56c5892b (UUPS proxy, impl 0xf47bb65f, no ProxyAdmin slot). The same 3/5 Safe controls the entire mint surface on both chains.
